integrity: Mathematical proof uses an exact 75-state relation closure and a 75-component integer vector identity; standalone standard-library checker and direct ring enumeration through length sixteen are provided. Self-review only.
scientific_limitations: One-step images of finite cyclic binary Rule 110 only; no multi-step or fixed-density classification. Relevant earlier preimage work was partially inaccessible; historical priority not independently certified.
title: Exact one-step image counts for cyclic elementary cellular automaton Rule 110
